tracks.title: 积木战争 V4-01｜轻装·前奏延展
tracks.direction: 最贴近前奏：拨弦律动与短主题持续循环
tracks.prompt: Instrumental acoustic strategy-game background cover, 132 BPM, steady 4/4. Use the source's FIRST INTRO PHRASE as the blueprint for the entire piece: its dry plucked rhythm, small scale, light-footed pulse and melodic charm. Four bars of mandolin offbeats, plucked bass and soft hand drum, then a warm mid-register fiddle quietly carries the opening motif into a memorable four-bar call and answer. Keep the intro's low-medium energy and SAME sparse density for all three minutes. One lead, one plucked accompaniment, simple bass, quiet pulse; melody above percussion. Repeat the hook with tiny ending-note variations, held answers and rests. Replace a part when changing color, never stack parts. Each eight-bar cycle returns to the opening groove; occasional two-bar thinning provides breath. Minor-key rhythmic tension suggests a nimble skirmish. Intimate dry mix, rounded attacks, natural dynamics. Continuous melodic gameplay loop, even level throughout, end on the opening pickup.

tracks.title: 积木战争 V4-02｜轻装·轻律回环
tracks.direction: 稍放缓：木笛与提琴换色但不叠加，能量保持平稳
tracks.prompt: Instrumental small-ensemble tactical game background cover, 128 BPM, steady 4/4. Extend the SOURCE INTRO'S gentle rhythmic character across the full three minutes. Keep its plucked offbeats and memorable opening melodic contour, never follow the source's later intensification. Begin with four bars of muted mandolin, plucked cello and soft hand drum. A rounded wooden flute unfolds a singable four-bar hook: short call, held answer, clear rests. A soft fiddle takes over the SAME melody every sixteen bars while the flute rests. Only one lead at a time, with three quiet supporting parts. Use A-A-A'-A cycles and slight melodic substitutions, stable harmony and recurring rhythmic accents to sustain a playful bridge-contest feeling. Keep constant low-medium energy, soft percussion, bass on strong beats, spacious midrange. Small two-bar reductions then return at exactly the prior level. Dry chamber sound, mellow treble, light transients. End with the opening rhythmic pickup for looping.
